title: Front Cover
content: Catching and tagging pygmy devil rays (Mobula hypostoma) in Destin, Florida. Research activity conducted by Mote Marine Laboratory under SAL-23-1140-SRP. This image relates to Research Article “Genetic and morphometric support for the Atlantic pygmy devil ray, Mobula hypostoma (Bancroft, 1831), in the eastern Atlantic Ocean” [https://doi.org/10.1002/aqc.70030] by Humble et al. Photo credit: Sean Thomas.
